label: Arrays
summary: SSL array creation, indexing, traversal, and array helper functions.
must_follow: Declare array variables before use and initialize arrays before appending.
Use adjacent commas with no spaces for skipped optional parameters.
Check ALen before reading an index from dynamic input.
avoid: Do not pass NIL as the target array to mutating array helpers.
Do not treat SSL arrays as zero-based .NET arrays.

elements.name: ArrayNew
elements.summary: Creates a new array with up to three dimensions.

elements.name: ALen
elements.summary: Returns the number of elements in an array.

elements.name: AAdd
elements.summary: Appends an element to the end of an array and returns the appended element.

elements.name: AScan
elements.summary: Returns the index of the first array element that matches a value or condition.

elements.name: AScanExact
elements.summary: Returns the index of the first array element that matches a value or condition exactly.

elements.name: AEval
elements.summary: Evaluates a code block for each array element and returns the same array.

elements.name: AEvalA
elements.summary: Evaluates a code block for each selected array element and writes the result back to the same array.

elements.name: AFill
elements.summary: Fills an array element range with the same value and returns the same array.

elements.name: DelArray
elements.summary: Removes an element from an array at a specified one-based index and returns the same array.

elements.name: BuildArray
elements.summary: Splits text into a one-dimensional array using a literal delimiter.

elements.name: BuildArray2
elements.summary: Parses text into a two-dimensional array using separate row and column delimiters.

elements.name: BuildString
elements.summary: Builds one string from array elements using a delimiter.

elements.name: BuildString2
elements.summary: Builds one string from a two-dimensional array using separate row and column delimiters.

elements.name: CompArray
elements.summary: Determines whether two arrays are exactly equal.

elements.name: SortArray
elements.summary: Sorts an array in place and returns the same array.
